gov12da.info.label.unverified: Default, not confirmed: this number is a starting value of the rule until the customer and the legal unit confirm it.
gov12da.info.source.text: Research on alert governance and control of capital projects, 08/11/2026
gov12da.rule.gift.formula: Declaration day = day received + the days of the rule; a gift worth more than the review line needs a second person; a gift over the keep line is returned or handed to the unit. The flags follow the rule of the day of the declaration.
gov12da.rule.photo.formula: Two photos of two projects are the same place when they are no further apart than the metres of the rule and the same moment when they are no further apart than the minutes of the rule; the same file (SHA-256) is always named. A signal to explain, nothing more.
gov12da.rule.standing.formula: Score = overdue x the overdue weight + disputed x the disputed weight + open x the open weight + (money still owed / money step) x the money weight. A higher score comes first, to prioritise follow-up only.
gov12da.rule.transmittal.formula: Review day = day sent + the days of the rule (review or approval); a recipient may be given one extension, later, with a reason. Progress = answers in over the people who must answer.
gov12da.rule.whistle.formula: Acknowledgement day = day received + the acknowledgement days; settlement day = day received + the settlement days, as the snapshot of the rule taken when the portal was configured.
